status: exploratory development protocol recorded before this iteration's outcome evaluation; not prospective preregistration
cohort: Binder opt5, existing 45 retained MCS/VS recordings; no new exclusions
original_envelope_missing_channel_policy: average available original channels, audit missing channels explicitly
trajectory: opt5 linear chirp f(t)=55-60*t, restricted to the stimulus interval [0,0.5] seconds
pre_evaluation_technical_correction: Initial implementation checks found STFT edge NaNs before -0.4453125 s in all 45 selected records. Background was changed from [-0.65,-0.30] to [-0.40,-0.30] before any candidate outcome evaluation; no patient removed and no values imputed.

features.original_t: existing phi_rec; mean of ITPC-derived EFR envelope in [0.20,0.35] s, not voltage amplitude
features.trajectory_t: trapezoidal frequency average of six-channel ITPC along f(t)=55-60*t at a fixed lag
features.specificity: (trajectory_t - same-frequency prestimulus ITPC)/(trajectory_t + same-frequency prestimulus ITPC); all-zero denominator returns zero
features.spatial_dispersion: population standard deviation of six channel trajectory integrals divided by their mean; all-zero mean returns zero

feature_interpretation: background is a matched measurement reference, not an unconscious-state biomarker; spatial dispersion has no presumed diagnostic sign or circuit localization
adaptive_models: secondary; lag chosen inside inner CV; no claim of single-trial latency correction or 10-ms physiological resolution
estimator: StandardScaler followed by L2 LogisticRegression; no class weighting; intercept fitted; solver lbfgs; max_iter 2000; tol 1e-8
selection_objective: unweighted mean inner-fold ROC AUC; ties within 1e-12 prefer smaller C then listed lag order; no outer-fold selection
unit: one retained recording per opt5 patient ID; opt2 is not evaluated or used for selection in v1
primary_metric: pooled outer OOF probability AUC; raw positive-direction original T AUC and mean outer-fold AUC also reported
secondary_metrics: OOF accuracy, balanced accuracy, sensitivity, specificity at probability 0.5
OOF sensitivity and specificity at a training-inner-OOF specificity target of 0.90
high_specificity_threshold: next representable float above the training-inner-OOF VS 90th percentile, quantile method higher; test prediction >= threshold; target is not guaranteed on held-out data

conditional_bootstrap.resampling: paired class-stratified recordings; fixed OOF scores only
conditional_bootstrap.scope: descriptive conditional intervals; do not propagate development selection, retraining, or overlapping CV training uncertainty; no confirmatory p-values

repetition_scope: same 45 recordings across five seeds; descriptive split sensitivity, not five independent studies; no best-seed or ensemble headline
success_reporting: report every frozen family and both primary deltas regardless of sign; no AUC acceptance assertion; do not claim superiority, novelty priority, mechanism confirmation, or external clinical validity from this development cohort
missing_values_policy: abort on missing subjects/channels, nonfinite ITPC in any actually used channel-frequency-time window, invalid finite ITPC range or empty windows; unused STFT edge NaNs are not imputed or used; no diagnosis-dependent rejection
scope: new outputs only under results/binder_itpc_v1; historical features, tables, labels, raw MAT/EDF and manuscript remain untouched
